messages.subject: Preorder
messages.text:
40 years ago as a student of agriculture I learned about the insulating properties of milkweed and tried to make my own sleeping bag (actually.... I paid my little brother to collect it and separate the fluff from the seeds but he soon quit on me;-). 

 I'm excited to finally see these products!
 

 I want to order some mittens for my family for Christmas but I am confused by the preorder dates: If it says "Pre-order November 2025" does that mean it is shipping now and so likely I can order it to be delivered (to Halifax) by Christmas??
 

 Thanks so much, and good luck!
 Nick Tinker

messages.subject: Re: Preorder
messages.text:
Hi Nick,
 

 First of all, thank you for your wonderful message — we loved the story about your milkweed sleeping bag project! 😊 That gave us a good smile.
 

 Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in responding. We’ve recently been short on resources in our customer service department. It’s not something we’re proud of, but we’re happy to say we’re catching up and getting back on track.
 

 The good news is that we do have mittens currently in stock. Orders shipping to Halifax should arrive in time for Christmas, depending on the shipping option selected.
 

 We also have a season-end promotion running at the moment:
 2 items: 10% off

 3–4 items: 15% off

 5 items or more: 20% off

 

 If you’d like help choosing styles or confirming delivery timelines, we’d be more than happy to assist.
 

 Thanks again for your enthusiasm and support
 

 

 Lasclay
